label: Heavy going
summary: The Iran war still dominates. Trump denied any talks with Tehran, and the Revolutionary Guard said its doctrine is turning offensive. A drone strike on a market in the disputed Abyei region killed at least 153 people. North Korea said it will restart border propaganda broadcasts, and Nigeria's first Ebola case matched the Congo strain. The UN warned the coming El Nino could be the strongest on record. Governments took websites offline after critical PHP flaws were found. Canada set aside C$6.2bn to protect manufacturers from US tariffs. On the other side, Putin agreed to resume three-way peace talks with Ukraine and the US, doctors said Pope Leo needs no further cancer treatment, NASA's Perseverance rover set an off-world driving record and Japan launched a mission to the Martian moon Phobos. The weighted formula gave 39; no editorial adjustment.
